description: This file is a shell script for testing SSH signed commits in a Git environment. It includes test cases for creating, verifying, and signing commits with GPG signatures, especially focusing on SSH keys and their trust levels. The script utilizes Git commands and GPG tooling to perform automated tests related to signed commits, signature validation, and signature signature manipulation.

methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.
